caption: The drawing features an oval platter with two decorative handles on either end. The platter is outlined in a light brownish-gold color, and its handles have yellow and brown accents. The surface of the platter is decorated with a floral design in the center, comprising pink and purple flowers, green and brown leaves, and a ribbon-like element in soft purple and green. There is a small wheat stalk in yellow and brown positioned above the flowers. Underneath the main platter illustration, there are two additional sketches: one shows a top and side view of the platter with minimal detail, and the other is an oval emblem with decorative lines containing the words "UNION WARRANTED C.T. MFG. Co." The background of the drawing is a light beige or off-white color, with all the elements framed within a rectangular pencil border. The artist’s signature, "J. Sudeik," appears near the lower right corner just below the platter.
title: Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
